edges.reason: msg.sender is validated against owns[cdp]/cdpCan in the cdpAllowed modifier.
msg.sender is validated against urn/urnCan in the urnAllowed modifier.
msg.sender must equal pool in the onlyPool modifier.
msg.sender must be present in members in the onlyMember modifier.
msg.sender is authorized through isAuthorized in the auth modifier.
msg.sender must be the owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender must equal manager in the onlyManager modifier.
msg.sender is passed as src into isAuthorized.
urnAllow uses msg.sender as the urn owner key.
deposit uses msg.sender as the member account.
Pool.bite uses msg.sender as the liquidator.
bitten compares tic[cdp]+GRACE with now, a timestamp dependency.
bite sets tic[cdp]=now and gates on the grace period.
chooseMember derives pseudo-randomness from now/1 hours.
Pool.topup decision depends on current time and oracle timing.
untop depends on bitten(cdp) which uses now.
BCdpScore.updateScore receives now as the time argument.
slashScore uses now/left to derive startTime.
cdpCan map is read inside cdpAllowed.
urnCan map is read inside urnAllowed.
pool state variable is compared in onlyPool.
members array is scanned in onlyMember.
cushion[cdp] is consumed when computing usedCushion.
cushion[cdp] is read and cleared in untop.
urns[cdp] resolves the urn address in bite.
ilks[cdp] resolves the collateral type in bite.
score address is used in BCdpScoreConnector.updateScore.
left[cdp] gates the external score update.
cdpData members/bite are read in Pool.bite.
quitB applies the note logging modifier.
emergencyExecute applies the note logging modifier.
deposit applies the note logging modifier.
withdraw applies the note logging modifier.
Pool.topup applies the note logging modifier.
Pool.untop applies the note logging modifier.
Pool.bite applies the note logging modifier.
note modifier emits an anonymous event via assembly log4.
emergencyExecute performs an arbitrary low-level target.call enabling reentrancy.
deposit calls vat.move before updating rad, allowing a reentrancy window.
withdraw calls vat.move as an external transfer.
Pool.topup calls man.topup after mutating cdpData.
Pool.bite calls man.bite then continues updating state.
LiquidationMachine.topup calls vat.move to pull DAI.
LiquidationMachine.topup calls vat.frob after the transfer.
untop calls vat.frob to return topping.
untop calls vat.move to send DAI to the pool.
connector forwards to the external score.updateScore.
open deploys a new UrnHandler contract.
BCdpManager.shift calls untop on both CDPs.
bite calls bitten to validate the grace period.
chooseMember recurses over the candidate list.
chooseMembers recurses over the candidate list.
calcCushion uses Math.add for rate base and duty.
calcCushion uses Math.mul for collateral/debt comparisons.
calcCushion compounds rates using the rpow assembly routine.
bite uses mul for art*rate and ink*spot comparisons.
bite uses sub for usedCushion and bart.
Pool.bite uses mul for the cushion portion and ink shares.
Pool.bite uses sub for the rad debit.
updateScore uses add for score accumulation.
resetCdp uses mul for the refund computation.
open uses add for cdpi and count.
give uses add/sub on the owner counts.

normalization_plan.reason: The cdp parameter is the key indexing owns/cdpCan inside the cdpAllowed authorization check.
The ilk parameter selects the collateral type consumed by the bite flow.
The dink collateral delta parameter is only meaningful inside the bite computation.
The dart debt delta parameter drives the bite computation.
The dst address parameter is the destination urn of the quit flow.
The usr parameter is the new owner recorded by open.
The time parameter is forwarded verbatim to the score update.
The data parameter is the raw payload of the arbitrary low-level call.
The target parameter is the address of the arbitrary low-level call.
The radVal amount parameter controls the member balance withdrawal.
The cdpSrc parameter identifies the source CDP of the shift.
The cdpDst parameter identifies the destination CDP of the shift.
The wad collateral amount parameter is passed to vat.flux.
The minInk parameter enforces the minimum seized collateral in Pool.bite.
The local urn address is resolved from urns[cdp] to run the bite.
The local rate is read from vat.ilks and used in the bite arithmetic.
The local dtab is the DAI amount computed for topup.
The local winners array is the member selection result used by topup.
The local index is the caller position inside the cdpData members array.
The local dMemberInk is the collateral share returned to the liquidator.
The local usedCushion is part of the bite cushion consumption math.
The local bart is the remaining debt passed to doBite.
The local chosen index is the timestamp-derived pseudo-random pick.
The local ink is the urn collateral balance used for safety checks.
The local art is the urn debt balance used for safety checks.
